findings.correction: If I wanted to escape on my own, I had to fulfill the Logout Quest’s condition: reaching the First Rate realm.
findings.current: If I wanted to escape on my own, I had to fulfill the conditions for the Logout Quest. And one of those conditions was reaching the **First Rate** realm.
findings.defect: The source names reaching First Rate as the fulfillment condition, not as one item on a longer list.
findings.rationale: 충족 조건은 [일류]의 경지에 오르는 것 identifies that condition as First Rate. “One of those conditions” adds extra requirements this sentence does not state.
findings.source: 자력으로 탈출하려면 로그아웃 퀘스트 조건을 충족시켜야 하고, 충족 조건은 [일류]의 경지에 오르는 것.

findings.correction: “Are you sure? You swear that on the name of the Medicine King Hall Leader?”
findings.current: “Are you sure? You swear that in the name of the Medicine King Hall?”
findings.defect: The oath is on the Medicine King Hall Leader’s name, not the Hall’s.
findings.rationale: 약왕당주 is the Hall Leader. 이름을 걸고 stakes that person’s name, not 약왕당.

findings.correction: White Tiger Hall Leader, was it? The man, whose name I didn’t even know, stared at me with obvious displeasure.
findings.current: The man who called himself the White Tiger Hall Leader stared at me with obvious displeasure.
findings.defect: He did not name himself; Taekyung recalls the title and notes he does not know the man’s name.
findings.rationale: 백호당주라고 했나 is hearsay/recollection of a title. 이름도 모르는 그 is the narrator’s ignorance of the personal name, not self-introduction.
findings.source: 백호당주라고 했나? 이름도 모르는 그는 썩 달갑지 않은 눈초리로 나를 응시했다.

findings.correction: “Then who was it that provoked the Mount Heng Sword Sect’s prized treasure and brought us to this crisis?”
findings.current: “Then who was it that laid hands on the Mount Heng Sword Sect’s treasured jewel and brought about the crisis we face today?”
findings.defect: “Laid hands on” plus “treasured jewel” turns 장중보옥을 건드려 into a suggestive physical/sexual reading the Korean does not fix.
findings.rationale: 장중보옥 is the set phrase for a jealously kept treasure or cherished person; 건드려 is interfere with/provoke. The English collocation implies molestation or seizure of a jewel-like person.
findings.source: “하면, 항산검문의 장중보옥을 건드려 작금의 사태에 이르게 한 것은 누구인가?”

findings.correction: *Do I need to take a spirit pill, an elixir, something like that?* / *Big brother, just give me one spirit pill,*
findings.current: *Do I need to eat an elixir or something?* / *Big brother, give me an elixir,*
findings.defect: 영단 and 영약 are listed as two things, then he would ask specifically for 영단; both become elixir.
findings.rationale: 영약 is bound as elixir. 영단 is named separately and is the item he would request from Jin Wikyung. Collapsing both erases that distinction.
findings.source: ‘영단, 영약. 뭐 이런 거라도 하나 먹어야 되나?’ / 눈 딱 감고 형, 나 영단 하나만 주라

findings.correction: I’d been letting it slide, and these bastards thought they could wrap me up like a cloth? Treat me like a doormat—보자기.
findings.current: Just because I had been letting it slide, did these bastards think I was a doormat?
findings.defect: The 보자 / 보자기 pun is replaced with an unrelated doormat image.
findings.rationale: 보자 보자 하니까 보자기로 보나 is wordplay on wait-and-see versus wrapping cloth. Doormat keeps contempt but drops the joke the line is built on.
findings.source: 이 새끼들이 보자 보자 하니까 누굴 보자기로 보나.

findings.correction: Fuming, I glared at the White Tiger Hall Leader as he sat down, then noticed something strange.
findings.current: I glared at the White Tiger Hall Leader as he returned to his seat, then noticed something strange.
findings.defect: Omits Taekyung huffing/fuming and adds that the Hall Leader “returned” to his seat.
findings.rationale: 씨근덕거리며 modifies the narrator’s glare. 자리에 앉는 is sitting down, not a stated return.
findings.source: 나는 씨근덕거리며 자리에 앉는 백호당주를 노려보다가 문득 이상한 점을 발견했다.

summary: Several binding meaning errors: quest condition narrowed in source but split in English, Hall Leader’s name sworn as the Hall’s, White Tiger Hall Leader treated as a self-chosen title, and 장중보옥 건드려 rendered as if he laid hands on a jewel.
